200 days from 1762-10-21:  
1762 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100, not by 400).  
Oct 21 + 10 days → Oct 31 (10 days),  
+ 30 → Nov 30 (40 days),  
+ 31 → Dec 31 (71 days),  
200 - 71 = 129 days into 1763.  
1763 is not leap. Jan 31 (31), Feb 28 (59), Mar 31 (90), Apr 30 (120).  
129 - 120 = 9 days into May → May 9, 1763.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1763-05-09
